# NordKiln

> NordKiln is a small Norwegian software studio. Its first product, NordKiln Scan (coming soon), is a launch-safety security scanner for apps built with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Bolt, v0, Lovable). Unlike most vibe-coding scanners, it logs in as two test users to check whether user B can read user A's data (broken access control / IDOR), and also checks for exposed API keys, Supabase tables without Row Level Security, leaked service_role keys and open Firebase rules. Findings come in plain English with fix prompts per tool, a re-scan, and a "verified safe to launch" badge. Free scan; $19 Launch Pass planned. Only apps you own can be scanned. A free client-side Supabase RLS checker is available at /tools/supabase-check/.

## Pages
- [Home and FAQ](https://nordkiln.dev/): overview and answers about vibe coding security, Supabase RLS, Firebase rules and leaked API keys
- [NordKiln Scan](https://nordkiln.dev/scan/): what is checked, how it works, planned pricing
- [Free Supabase RLS checker](https://nordkiln.dev/tools/supabase-check/): browser-only tool to see if the anon key can read tables, detect service_role leaks and common API secrets; nothing uploaded
- [Privacy](https://nordkiln.dev/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://nordkiln.dev/terms/): scan only apps you own or are authorized to test
